core.title: Yale Augusta Lever Mortise Lock, Yale AUR8805FL626

text.description_html:
Yale Augusta Lever Mortise Lock, Yale AUR8805FL626

Yale Augusta lever features a ADA compliant return to door design that is field reversible for easy and flexible installation. The Heavy duty Copenhagen rose trim features no visible screws making it resistant to abuse and vandalism. The deadbolt latch is stainless steel reinforced for security. It will fit doors with: 2-3/4 inch backset that are 1-3/4 inches thick.

Features: for Yale Augusta Lever Mortise Lock

  • UL Cycle above and beyond test completed at 12.3 Million Cycles. Verification ID: V572228e
  • ANSI/BHMA Certified Grade 1 for long-life and durability
  • UL/cUL listed for 3 hour fire rated doors
  • 10 year mechanical warranty

Specifications: for Yale Augusta Lever Mortise Lock

  • Finish: Satin Chrome
  • Lever Length: 4-1/2"
  • Rose Diameter: 2-9/16"
  • Projection: 2-1/4"
  • Door Thickness: 1-3/4"
  • Backsets: 2-3/4"
  • Strike: 1-1/4" curved lip strike
  • Deadbolt: 1" throw, cast stainless steel
  • Handing: Field reversible
  • Door Prep: Fits standard 161 door prep.
  • Function: Classroom
  • Keyways: Yale 2153 cylinder standard

Classroom Function:

  • Latchbolt retracted by knob/lever either side, except when outside knob/lever is locked by key.
  • Inside knob/lever always active
  • Latchbolt can be retracted by key when outside knob/lever is locked
  • Operating inside knob/lever retracts latchbolt, but outside knob/lever remains locked
  • Deadlocking latchbolt

Sold Individually
